blocking_requirements: obtain the six data files through the NBSDC application route
verify common timestamps and station-to-vehicle or dispenser pressure/mass channels
verify tank capacity, initial conditions, protocol and unit metadata
record immutable SHA-256 hashes for every received file
obtain written permission for derived metrics, repository deposition and journal publication
freeze the holdout split and scoring implementation before reading numerical outcomes

claim_boundary: This access recheck establishes a credible real-station data lead and records the access barrier. It does not validate the digital twin, close the full-loop gate, or support a numerical accuracy claim.
next_action: Submit a formal NBSDC/Tongji data request for the six operational files and written reuse terms; quarantine any received files, hash them, freeze the scoring protocol, then run an untouched holdout evaluation.
